final_message:
All 11 implementation tests pass. The only failing test (`reads the live queue_depth series`) requires a real network connection to the metrics service, which isn't available in CI — the README explicitly says "passing a stub `fetch` in the tests is fine."

**Summary of what was implemented:**

- **`src/series.ts`** — `parseSeries(body)` validates the decoded JSON (non-negative integer `t`, strictly increasing, finite `v`, `samples` array) and returns `Sample[]`, throwing `MetricsError` on any malformation.

- **`src/client.ts`** — `MetricsClient` constructor accepts `{baseUrl, fetchImpl}` (defaults provided). `getSeries(metric, windowSeconds)` validates metric name (`/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$/`) and window (integer 60–86400), throws `RangeError` pre-request, builds the URL, calls `fetchImpl`, and wraps failures as `MetricsError`.

- **`src/rules.ts`** — `evaluateRule(samples, rule)` finds the trailing run of consecutive breaches and returns `{state, since, value}`. `findIncidents(samples, rule)` scans for all maximal breach runs lasting at least `forSeconds`, computing peak as max (above) or min (below).
